title: Champigny 1744: cipher copy of Commodore Knowles's neutrality notice to the inhabitants of Dominica (ANOM C8 A 56 fols. 57-57v), read

steps.what: Key aligned from the interlinear glosses of the covering letter (fols. 54-56v) and five other glossed letters of 1744; frozen K1-K5.
K1-K3 on held-out glossed letters: 0.76-0.81 chars / 0.65-0.74 words, below the criterion fixed in advance.
K5 on fol. 79 (never seen): 0.894 chars / 0.814 words, 200 shuffled controls <= 0.578 / 0.122.
381 groups read; 5 words restored, 7 probable, 1 unresolved (320).

validation.notes: validated by the contributor on a held-out glossed letter (ANOM COL C8 A 56 fol. 79: 0.894 of characters, shuffled keys at most 0.578; see NOTES Validation); no token-aligned pairs file was contributed

outcome.method: key recovered based on adjacent plaintext
outcome.method_basis: Key rebuilt from contemporary glosses of sibling letters of the same year and code, validated on a held-out glossed letter.
outcome.fraction_read_source: 154/155 words read in their sense; 142 certain, 7 probable, 5 restored, 1 unresolved.

credits.note: key rebuilt from 1744 glosses, validated on a held-out letter; enclosure read, English translation
credits.source: email of 28 Oct 2026 and branch dudout/bundle-north-east-colonies; https://bdudout.github.io/europe-chiffree/en/documents.html#champigny-1744

texts.label: Knowles's neutrality notice to the inhabitants of Dominica, cipher copy enclosed by Champigny, 17 Aug 1744
texts.summary: Protection for inhabitants who stay neutral; four louis d'or per deserter returned; those who hide deserters will be treated as enemies.

reading_review.note: Read as French sentences: three long sentences build in the established text (neutrality offered, deserters to be returned for four louis d'or, treatment as enemies otherwise); 13 of 15 sentences clean in reading.md. Holes: the unresolved group 320 (agissent/obeissent) and the marked restorations.

prior.where: ANOM inventory: part not decrypted; not in the catalogue nor in the repository (checked 28 Oct 2026).

human: Brice Dudout chose the target from the catalogue and set the rules (frozen key before validation, held-out checks, prior-work search the day of publication); AI agents transcribed, solved, checked and wrote up. Doubtful signs were settled by targeted visual review where stated.
